dogecoin.text: On May 8, Elon Musk will perform on #SaturdayNightLive. He tweeted that he'll talk about #dogecoin. Dogecoin's rate rose sharply. Now dogecoin is the third cryptocurrency in terms of capitalization. How'll Doge behave at night? Jump higher? Or start talking? :) #ElonMusk https://t.co/gBtt2RNWox

Yesterday #ElonMusk performed on the show #SaturdayNightLive. On expectations that he'd mention #Dogecoin, Doge's rate rose. Now I remembered the song "London Bridge Is Falling Down". Doge's rate after the program fell by 28%. It looks like it grows better on expectations. :) https://t.co/eW5tJ2OpwF

The #Dogecoin price has changed several times in a few days. Before #ElonMusk went to #SaturdayNightLive it grew, fell during the show. Musk tweeted he'd accept payment for #Tesla in Dogecoin, the rate jumped 30% again. It looks like Elon Musk's springboard works for Doge too. :) https://t.co/g3SdnvCaAi
